records.text: Jack Solomon married Karla Frantzve in 2002 and financed the restoration of Zion Gate in Jerusalem.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Carla (Carla Frantzve) wasn't even married to Jack (Jack Solomon) until 2002. ... Solomon is the very man who financed the restoration of Zion's Gate in Jerusalem.

verification.notes: Biographical data identifies Jack David Solomon's 2002 marriage to Karla, and the Jerusalem Foundation independently lists Jack David and Pamela Solomon as donors to a 1984 Zion Gate preservation project. The evidence supports both the marriage timing and an earlier Zion Gate connection.

records.text: Jack Solomon graduated from Utah Valley University, created its Center for Jewish Studies, taught political science at BYU, and formerly directed BYU's Jerusalem Center.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He graduated from what is today known as Utah Valley University. ... He also created on their campus the Center for Jewish Studies. ... Jack Solomon was also a professor at BYU in political science. ... He's the former director of the University's Jerusalem Center.

verification.notes: Available biographical data lists Jack Solomon's education at Los Angeles City College, Los Angeles State College, and California State University rather than Utah Valley University. BYU's institutional history identifies David Galbraith, not Solomon, as the Jerusalem Center's first director, contradicting the central assertions.

records.text: Jack Solomon and Norman Vance founded Advanced Patent Technology in 1968; it manufactured slot machines, later bought United Coin, and announced the Colorado Belle Hotel and Casino.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: it's because back in 1968, ... Jack (Jack Solomon) and his business partner, ... a man named Norman Vance, ... began a company called Advanced Patent Technology. ... That company would go on to manufacture slot machines. ... Jack (Jack Solomon) gathered more than $5 million to purchase United Coin, ... In 1979, ... they announced plans for the Colorado Bell Hotel and Casino in Laughlin, Nevada,

verification.notes: Jack Solomon's biography supports his leadership of APT from 1968 and credits him with development associated with the Colorado Belle. Reliable current sources did not establish all of the additional claims about Norman Vance, United Coin Machine Company, and ownership of a slot-machine chain.

records.text: Jack David Solomon founded the company now known as Bally Technologies.

appearances.snippet: I should mention Jack was also the founder of what is today known as Bally Technologies.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting identifies Jack David Solomon as founder of Advanced Patent Technology; the company lineage later used the Bally Technologies name.

records.text: The dedication at Zion's Gate in Israel belongs to Jack David Solomon's family, not Erika Kirk's family.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And Zion's Gate in Israel is his family's dedication, not Erica (Erika Kirk)'s, but his family's dedication.

verification.notes: No reliable public dedication record or donor register was found that can distinguish a Solomon-family dedication from an Erika-family dedication at Zion Gate.
